rule: The original-passage-scope status supports only the bounded claim stated here. Neither inferred arguments nor synthetic objections are author quotations. Whole-debate publication certification and independent theological/French approval remain false.

stages.precise_original_locator: On Liberty IV, society and individual, opening ¶¶
stages.claim_scope_en: Mill limits coercion, not religious moral argument.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Mill limite la contrainte, non le raisonnement moral religieux.

stages.precise_original_locator: On Liberty IV, on persuasion and self-regarding virtues
stages.claim_scope_en: Mill permits persuasion, education and non-coercive counsel.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Mill admet la persuasion, l'éducation et le conseil non coercitif.

stages.claim_scope_en: Natural law protects multiple goods, not simply avoidance of harm.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La loi naturelle protège plusieurs biens, non la seule absence de tort.

stages.claim_scope_en: Moral object differs from civil coercion and from calculations of harm.
stages.claim_scope_fr: L'objet moral diffère de la contrainte civile et du calcul des préjudices.

stages.claim_scope_en: Natural-law goods and moral object supply the Catholic line of reasoning.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Les biens de loi naturelle et l'objet moral fondent l'argument catholique.

stages.precise_original_locator: On Liberty IV as philosophical context
stages.claim_scope_en: The counterquestion about Catholic authority is our constructed objection, not Mill's quotation.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La contre-objection sur l'autorité catholique est construite, non citée de Mill.

stages.claim_scope_en: Public moral reasoning does not entail civil prohibition.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Un raisonnement moral public n'implique pas une interdiction civile.

stages.claim_scope_en: Harm is relevant but cannot exhaust analysis of the chosen act.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Le dommage compte sans épuiser l'analyse de l'acte choisi.

stages.claim_scope_en: No original author established for the claim that all consensual marital acts are good.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Aucun auteur original n'est établi pour la thèse que tout acte conjugal consenti est bon.

stages.claim_scope_en: Consent guidance has not been compared to this exact marital claim.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Le guide du consentement n'a pas été rapproché de cette thèse conjugale précise.

stages.claim_scope_en: Marriage establishes distinct and exclusive conjugal rights.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Le mariage établit des droits conjugaux propres et exclusifs.

stages.claim_scope_en: Mutual permission does not override fidelity or the moral norm.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La permission mutuelle n'annule ni la fidélité ni la norme morale.

stages.claim_scope_en: Text explicitly supports marital exclusivity and respect for the act.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Le texte appuie expressément l'exclusivité et le respect de l'acte.

stages.precise_original_locator: General consent discourse, not verified author text
stages.claim_scope_en: The comeback about harm and agreement is authored, not quoted.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La réplique sur dommage et accord est construite, non citée.

stages.claim_scope_en: Consent alone does not decide fidelity and conjugal integrity.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Le seul consentement ne tranche pas fidélité et intégrité conjugale.

stages.claim_scope_en: Marital agreement cannot make every choice permissible.
stages.claim_scope_fr: L'accord matrimonial ne peut rendre licite tout choix.

stages.precise_original_locator: Curran 1987 ¶¶ on physicalism, person and marriage
stages.claim_scope_en: Curran actually challenges biological reductionism, not merely harm.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Curran critique réellement le biologisme, non seulement le dommage.

stages.precise_original_locator: Curran 1987, paragraphs on physicalism and good of marriage
stages.claim_scope_en: Curran's original criticism values personal and matrimonial ends rather than a purely biological description.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La critique originale de Curran fait valoir les biens de la personne et du mariage contre une lecture purement biologique.

stages.precise_original_locator: Pius XII 1951, paragraphs on serious reasons and prolonged use of infertile periods
stages.claim_scope_en: Pius XII recognizes potentially prolonged avoidance of pregnancy when serious grounds exist.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Pie XII reconnaît la possibilité d'éviter durablement une grossesse pour de sérieux motifs.

stages.claim_scope_en: Good reasons do not automatically authorize every chosen means.
stages.claim_scope_fr: De bonnes raisons ne légitiment pas automatiquement tout moyen.

stages.precise_original_locator: Casti §§53–56; HV §§11–14; Pius XII 1951 on infertile periods
stages.claim_scope_en: Direct contraception is condemned; not every medical intervention.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La contraception directe est condamnée, non toute intervention médicale.

stages.claim_scope_en: The brief comeback about biology is a fair synthetic question, not a quotation.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La réplique sur la biologie est construite, non une citation.

stages.claim_scope_en: Reply now addresses chosen means instead of mere anatomy.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La réponse traite du moyen choisi, non de la seule anatomie.

stages.claim_scope_en: Responsible avoidance can have just grounds; means remain contested.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Éviter une grossesse peut être justifié ; les moyens restent contestés.

stages.precise_original_locator: Curran 1987 discusses physicalism, not this particular NFP analogy
stages.claim_scope_en: No original NFP-versus-contraception wording verified in Curran.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Aucune formule PFN/contraception précise n'est attestée chez Curran.

stages.claim_scope_en: The alleged proponent's comparison has not been checked.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La comparaison prêtée à l'adversaire n'a pas été contrôlée.

stages.precise_original_locator: Pius XII 1951, serious reasons and infertile periods
stages.claim_scope_en: Avoidance of conception can be deliberately intended in periodic abstinence.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La continence périodique peut viser intentionnellement à éviter une conception.

stages.claim_scope_en: The intended end and the means are distinct moral considerations.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La fin visée et le moyen sont moralement distincts.

stages.claim_scope_en: Periodic abstinence and direct contraception are explicitly distinguished.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La continence périodique et la contraception directe sont distinguées.

stages.precise_original_locator: Curran 1987 is not the author of this exact challenge
stages.claim_scope_en: 'Contraception by omission' is an illustrative objection.
stages.claim_scope_fr: « Contraception par omission » est une objection illustrative.

stages.claim_scope_en: The difference in means does not automatically make motives virtuous.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La différence des moyens ne rend pas toute intention vertueuse.

stages.claim_scope_en: The summary concerns the moral means, not outcome alone.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La synthèse porte sur le moyen moral, non le seul résultat.

stages.precise_original_locator: Curran 1987 does not use this NFP slogan
stages.claim_scope_en: 'Catholic contraception' is an authored slogan, not original Curran text.
stages.claim_scope_fr: « Contraception catholique » est une formule rédigée, non de Curran.

stages.claim_scope_en: The stated appeal cannot be claimed as that author's original passage.
stages.claim_scope_fr: L'attrait invoqué n'est pas établi comme passage original de l'auteur.

stages.precise_original_locator: Pius XII 1951, habitual avoidance without grave reasons
stages.claim_scope_en: Pius XII says selfish habitual recourse lacks justification.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Pie XII refuse de justifier un recours habituel égoïste.

stages.claim_scope_en: Different means matter even when desired outcomes coincide.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Les moyens diffèrent même pour une fin commune.

stages.claim_scope_en: Recourse to infertile periods is conditionally licit.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Le recours aux périodes infécondes est licite sous conditions.

stages.precise_original_locator: No identical objection quotation in Curran
stages.claim_scope_en: The physicalist challenge here is a synthetic follow-up.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La contre-objection physicaliste est construite.

stages.claim_scope_en: The relevant distinction is the deliberate conduct, not mere technology.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La distinction porte sur la conduite délibérée, non la technique.

stages.claim_scope_en: Bad motives may make periodic abstinence morally deficient.
stages.claim_scope_fr: De mauvais motifs peuvent vicier la continence périodique.

stages.precise_original_locator: PP_BIRTHCONTROL is a methods page, not this spouse dilemma
stages.claim_scope_en: No proponent of the forced-choice marital dilemma has been verified.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Aucun auteur du dilemme conjugal imposé n'est vérifié.

stages.claim_scope_en: This source does not establish claims about marital obligation or coercion.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Cette source n'établit pas les devoirs conjugaux ou la contrainte.

stages.claim_scope_en: Pius XI distinguishes the spouse doing wrong from the spouse wronged.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Pie XI distingue l'auteur du mal du conjoint lésé.

stages.claim_scope_en: Consent and moral cooperation require separate distinctions.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Consentement et coopération morale se distinguent.

stages.claim_scope_en: Conditional unwilling tolerance does not approve contraception.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La tolérance réticente conditionnelle n'approuve pas la contraception.

stages.precise_original_locator: Constructed counterquestion, not verified opponent quotation
stages.claim_scope_en: A tense marriage is not a blanket exemption.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Un mariage tendu n'est pas une exemption générale.

stages.precise_original_locator: Casti §59; ST I-II q18 on circumstances and object
stages.claim_scope_en: Grave reason, reluctance, and charity limit the teaching's application.
stages.claim_scope_fr: Raison grave, réticence et charité limitent son application.

stages.claim_scope_en: Conclusion distinguishes toleration from endorsement.
stages.claim_scope_fr: La conclusion distingue tolérance et approbation.
